recommendations.title: Immediate Relaunch of High-Engagement Creative
recommendations.detail: The 'JULY ADS 2026' campaign demonstrated exceptional creative resonance with a 4.33% CTR. Relaunch this creative immediately under a new 'AUGUST' campaign structure, as lead flow is currently zero.

recommendations.title: CPM Mitigation Strategy
recommendations.detail: Historical data shows an extremely high CPM of $355.78. To lower this, broaden targeting to include Advantage+ Audience settings and expand the geographic radius around the dealership to improve delivery efficiency.

recommendations.title: Transition to Lead-Specific Optimization
recommendations.detail: With a historical cost-per-message of $87.28, focus on optimizing for 'On-Facebook Leads' via Messenger. Implement a lead form or automated qualifying questions to ensure the high cost justifies the lead quality.
